verdict.rationale: Freshsales is a CRM with built-in Freddy AI features, so letting it connect to external MCP servers as a client is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only its REST API endpoints and Freddy AI lead and deal features, with no mention of connecting to or using MCP servers. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
